# vue3-json-to-excel

> Vue 3 component that exports JSON to an Excel (.xlsx) file in the browser, built on SheetJS (xlsx). The project site is an online JSON to Excel converter that runs on the component.

Install with `npm i vue vue3-json-to-excel`. `<vue3-json-to-excel :jsonData="rows" fileName="report" buttonText="Download" />` renders a link that downloads `report.xlsx`. `jsonData` is an object (one row) or an array of objects (one row each), with the keys as column headers. Nested objects become dotted columns such as `shipping.city`, and arrays inside an object are written to one cell as JSON text. Arrays and nested objects need a release newer than 1.0.5; 1.0.5 writes one flat object as one row. The default export also has an `install()` method, so `app.use()` registers it globally.

## Docs

- [JSON to Excel converter](https://halitsever.github.io/vue3-json-to-excel/): online converter, component usage, options and FAQ
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/Readme.MD): install, usage, props and a full example
- [Component source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/vue3-json-to-excel.vue): props, defaults, flattening and the export logic
- [Plugin entry](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/entry.esm.js): default export with install() for app.use()
- [Dev example](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/dev/serve.vue): the local playground that `npm run serve` starts

## Optional

- [Site source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/tree/main/site): the converter page, built with `npm run build:site`
